llms.body:
# Labcorp (Laboratory Corporation of America)

> Labcorp is a global leader in life sciences, CRO(Clinical research organization) and comprehensive laboratory services, delivering vital diagnostic insights and drug development solutions to patients, healthcare providers, health systems and biopharmaceutical organizations.
This file provides a structured index of official Labcorp endpoints for use by Large Language Models, AI search agents, and automated crawlers.

## Patients & Individuals
- [Patient Gateway](https://www.labcorp.com/patients): Main portal for individual health tracking and consumer tools.
- [Labs & Appointments](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/labs-and-appointments): Schedule, modify, or locate patient service centers for bloodwork and collections.
- [Billing & Insurance](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/billing): Financial guidelines, insurance coverage verification, and payment services.
- [Test Directory for Patients](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/tests): Patient-centric information detailing routine screenings and specialized laboratory testing.
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/health-wellness): Educational resources regarding preventative health, lifestyle testing, and condition management.
- [MyLabcorp app](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/mylabcorp): Use the MyLabcorp patient app to track your lab tests, interpret results with AI support, and manage appointments and payments with ease and privacy.

## Healthcare Providers
- [Provider Gateway](https://www.labcorp.com/providers): Hub for clinical workflows, medical professional tools, and portal access.
- [Clinical Testing Services](https://www.labcorp.com/providers/testing): Advanced diagnostic testing capabilities and specimen requirements for clinics.
- [Test Menu Search](https://www.labcorp.com/test-menu/search): Full searchable directory of laboratory procedures, methodologies, and reference ranges.
- [Test Menu](https://www.labcorp.com/tests/): Directory of all lab tests offered by Labcorp. Includes test numbers and CPT codes.
- [Clinical Treatment Areas](https://www.labcorp.com/providers/treatment-areas): Diagnostic therapeutic focus fields, including oncology, genetics, and infectious diseases.
- [Medical Resources](https://www.labcorp.com/providers/resources): Practice management tools, guideline updates, and clinical reference materials.

## Knowledge & Science Library
- [Science & Innovation](https://www.labcorp.com/science): Information on scientific advancements, proprietary diagnostic developments, and clinical trial innovations.
- [Education & Events Hub](https://www.labcorp.com/education-events): Educational ecosystem featuring continuing medical education (CME) and expert panels.
- [Scientific Articles](https://www.labcorp.com/education-events/articles): Peer-reviewed insights, white papers, and technical briefs from clinical leaders.
- [Events Calendar](https://www.labcorp.com/education-events/events): Upcoming healthcare webinars, medical conferences, and organizational presentations.

## Data & Technology Solutions
- [Data Ecosystem](https://www.labcorp.com/data): Enterprise health IT platforms and data connectivity resources.
- [Diagnostic Assistant](https://www.labcorp.com/data/diagnostic-assistant): Algorithmic decision-support and interpretative data solutions for clinicians.
- [Insight Analytics](https://www.labcorp.com/data/insight-analytics): Population health informatics and advanced healthcare data metrics.
- [Labcorp Link](https://www.labcorp.com/data/labcorp-link): The secure, proprietary portal used to order tests and securely view clinical results online.
- [EMR/EHR Vendor Integration](https://www.labcorp.com/data/emr-vendors): Interoperability standards for connecting lab reporting with electronic health record systems.
- [Technology](https://www.labcorp.com/about/our-story/technology): Learn about Labcorp's technology innovations, including smarter workflows, more connected experiences, and better ways to advance science and care.

## Health Systems & Organizations
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations): Portal for institutional healthcare stakeholders, reference networks, and regional partnerships.
- [Organizations We Serve](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/organizations-we-serve): Customized workflows tailored for hospitals, health plans, employers, and government entities.
- [Enterprise Capabilities](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/capabilities): Core capabilities including supply chain management, operational scaling, and outsourced laboratory management.
- [Institutional Resources](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/resources): Compliance materials, analytical documentation, and operational brochures.

## Biopharmaceutical Services
- [Biopharma Drug Development](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma): Full-suite drug lifecycle support from discovery to commercialization.
- [Nonclinical Development](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/nonclinical): Early-stage discovery, safety assessment, and lead optimization testing.
- [Central Laboratories](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs): Global centralized infrastructure for clinical trials testing.
- [Scientific Disciplines](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/disciplines): Core analytical areas including flow cytometry, genomics, and biomarkers.
- [Therapeutic Experience](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/therapeutic-experience): Specialized clinical trial operations across oncology, rare diseases, and immunology.
- [Global Trial Connect](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/global-trial-connect): Investigator site optimization and sample management networks.
- [Central Labs Excellence](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/why-work): Core differentiators and scaling infrastructure of the central lab platform.
- [Central Labs Insights](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/cls-insights): Publications focusing on optimization, logistics, and data strategy within clinical testing.
- [Commercialization Solutions](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization): Market access strategies, real-world evidence tracking, and patient access mapping.
- [Commercialization Data & Tech](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/data-tech): Clinical trial lab data applications, nonclinical modeling, and data-driven insights to optimize study design and patient recruitment.
- [Artificial Intelligence in Drug Development](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/ai): Designing AI models and automated analyses to predict patient patterns and streamline product development pipelines.
- [Regulatory Consulting](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/regulatory): Full-service global CRO support for navigating international regulatory agencies and ensuring clinical filing compliance.
- [Sponsored Testing Initiatives](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/sponsored-testing): Collaborative programs designed to provide patient access to novel therapies while developing key companion diagnostic data.
- [Promoting Your Therapy](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/promote-your-therapy): Point-of-care patient engagement platforms, including Labcorp TV, to introduce therapies to targeted demographics.
- [Life Science Investors](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/commercialization/investors): Strategic investor services and end-to-end portfolio development to manage risk and accelerate asset commercialization.
- [Biopharma Partnership Advantages](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/why-work): Operational metrics, global footprint, and multi-disciplinary data capabilities.
- [Biopharma Insights](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/biopharma-insights): Comprehensive thought leadership on global trial design, clinical strategy, and therapeutic trends.

## Corporate Profile
- [About Corporate](https://www.labcorp.com/about): Official mission statement, executive leadership, and investor relations access points.
- [Newsroom](https://www.labcorp.com/newsroom): Press releases, media kits, operational updates, and corporate announcements.
- [Careers Portal](https://careers.labcorp.com/): Official hiring board for clinical laboratory scientists, phlebotomists, and operations.

## Oncology
- [Labcorp Oncology](https://www.labcorp.com/oncology): Oncology-specific diagnostics. Our testing menu arms you with the most modern tools to help patients through the entire cancer care continuum — from screening and preventive care to clear cancer diagnosis to identifying optimal evidence-based treatments and tracking your patient’s response.
- [For Providers](https://www.labcorp.com/oncology/providers): Our comprehensive, specialized diagnostic testing menu keeps you informed throughout the continuum of care—from screening, diagnosis and prognosis to treatment options and response.
- [For Biopharma Partners](https://www.labcorp.com/oncology/biopharma): Our global oncology-specific expertise helps advance cancer diagnostics, drugs and devices through the full drug development continuum with speed and efficiency. 
- [For Patients](https://www.labcorp.com/oncology/patients): From routine cancer screenings, to understanding hereditary cancer risk to biomarker testing to help guide cancer treatment, we are here to support you throughout your cancer journey. 


## Women's Health
- [Labcorp Women's Health](https://www.labcorp.com/womens-health): Labcorp Women's Health and Genetic Testing: We aspire to be the lab that supports women's needs wherever they are in their lives, whatever their health and personal situation, wherever they go for their testing and whomever they see.
- [Labcorp Women's Health Test Menu](https://www.labcorp.com/womens-health/providers/test-menu): Labcorp's Women's Health test menu provides a comprehensive list of specialty and general laboratory testing services.
- [Women's Health for Patients](https://www.labcorp.com/womens-health/patients): If you're looking to learn more about annual health screening, fertility and sexual health, testing during pregnancy, how testing may differ as you age, and more, consider Labcorp your source.
- [Women's Health for Healthcare Providers](https://www.labcorp.com/womens-health/providers): We aim to be your dedicated partner for leading-edge women's health medical laboratory tests and services
- [Labcorp Women's Health Cost Estimator](https://www.labcorp.com/womens-health/patients/cost-estimator): Estimate costs of pre-pregnancy and pregnancy Labcorp tests.
